grafana.pipeline_limit: The public labels identify the exporter and ingestion job but not the device model, source field, unit conversion or reset policy.

pressure.semantics: The series is pressure-like and varies substantially between stations, but no primary evidence states whether it is absolute/local, relative, or corrected to sea level. Numeric plausibility is auxiliary evidence only.
pressure.origin: Prometheus exposes an InfluxDB-exported metric produced through job nodered-dedicats; the originating device and source field are not identified.
blocking_reasons: No unit is declared by the dashboard, returned field or Prometheus metadata.
No evidence distinguishes local/absolute pressure from sea-level-corrected pressure.
No documented device model or source-field contract was found.
The available station/location baseline does not document elevations, and altitude was not inferred from names or coordinates.

rain.counter_semantics: Observed as a non-decreasing accumulator between discontinuities. It is not a daily accumulator in the sampled periods, but its start epoch, reset trigger and physical unit are undocumented.

promql_reset_indicators.note: The reset() indicator was repeatable, but the sampled raw values around its first positive evaluation did not contain a visible decrease; this signal remains inconclusive.

annual_aggregate.behavior: At least one real decrease/discontinuity exists. The cause and reset policy are unknown. Missing or non-aligned samples mean the dashboard expression did not expose a negative result around the confirmed event.

rain.derived_24h_semantics: The expression is a rolling difference only while the base accumulator remains comparable across both instants. It contains no reset correction and cannot be treated as universally equivalent to precipitation over 24 hours.
blocking_reasons: The base unit is not declared.
The accumulator epoch and reset trigger are not documented.
A real counter decrease was observed, while the dashboard query has no reset handling.
The rolling difference cannot be mapped unequivocally to any existing canonical rain field.

required_new_evidence: Producer/source-field documentation declaring pressure unit and correction semantics.
Producer/source-field documentation declaring rain unit, accumulator epoch and reset policy.
A reset-safe, source-approved definition for a canonical 24-hour rain value.

notes: No full Grafana payloads or secrets are stored.
No canonical mapping is inferred from metric names or numeric ranges.
No production, database, backend, frontend, snapshot or migration change was made.
